{{Short description|City in Ukhdari}}

'''Ardashun''' is a city in [[Ukhdari]] in central [[Ayuma]]. It was one of nine cities selected as a host city for the [[1760 FLLA World Cup]].

Ardashun Field, a 45,600-seat stadium newly built for the tournament, hosted seven matches at the 1760 World Cup, including the round-of-sixteen tie between [[Etirha]] and [[Acetoa]] on 30 June 1760. Construction of the venue overran the original budget by an estimated 14 per cent, the highest overrun of any of the nine host city projects.
